rationale: Hold exploration and learning rate fixed; compare two fresh training budgets to isolate the episode-budget change. Exploration 0.20 balances random collection and use of learned values; learning rate 0.0001 is the supplied reference.
prediction_before_training: The 200-episode agent may collect more pellets and achieve a higher five-game mean than the 50-episode agent because it receives more experience and updates. Improvement is uncertain; outcomes may be noisy or deteriorate.
next_gate: Compare the 50- and 200-episode evidence before deciding on 500 episodes.
